title: {Syn} Mersenne Primes Hide in Powers of Two
content:
A Mersenne prime has the form 2^p - 1, and p itself must be prime. The reverse is not guaranteed: 2^11 - 1 equals 2047, which factors as 23 times 89.

Mersenne primes are famous partly because the Lucas-Lehmer test is especially efficient for this form, making them natural targets in record prime searches.

Why it matters: number theory keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
